name: media.create
description: A file's record before its upload: kind by type, under the client's id, with a key the core makes. Answers the record, a signed write URL and the file's stable address. The same id again answers with the record it made; an id another brand holds is refused.
sql:
with made as (
  insert into brandbase.media as m (id, brand_id, storage_key, kind, mime, name, bytes, width, height, duration_s)
  values (:id, :brand, :file,
    case when :mime like 'image/%' then 'photo' when :mime like 'video/%' then 'video' else 'file' end,
    :mime, coalesce(:name, ''), :bytes, :width, :height, :durationS)
  on conflict (id) do update set id = excluded.id where m.brand_id = excluded.brand_id
  returning m.*
)
select jsonb_build_object('media', brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(made)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(made.created_at)),
  'upload', jsonb_build_object('key', made.storage_key, 'type', made.mime)) as result
from made
